About Us
Assaggini Wine Bar & Restaurant is a much-loved local venue in the heart of Mornington, known for modern Italian food, great wine and a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere.

Our menu focuses on quality ingredients, bold Italian flavours and dishes designed to be enjoyed and shared. We pride ourselves on delivering consistently great food and creating a dining experience that keeps our guests coming back.
